en-US.name: AWS CloudHSM CLI
en-US.releaseNotes: Client SDK 5.18.0 adds ML-DSA (ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65 and ML-DSA-87) key pair generation, signing and verification, and PureEdDSA (Ed25519) signing and verification, to CloudHSM CLI. It also adds Ubuntu 26.04 LTS support, resolves an issue where the key-reference filter could not select session keys, and improves throttling handling and automatic retry behavior.
